```{python}
#| label: fig-polygon-edge-coordinates
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "An edge-local view of a changing gap. The coordinate system follows the source edge even when the original layout is rotated."
#| fig-alt: "A blue source conductor has a horizontal top edge. The lower edge of a green target slopes away, with gap d0 at left and larger gap d1 at right. A narrow vertical slice is marked dx."
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import drawsvg as dw
project_root = Path(os.environ.get('QUARTO_PROJECT_ROOT', '.')).resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(project_root / 'figures'))
from polygon_diagram_helpers import INK, SOURCE, TARGET, SHIELD, ACCENT, label, arrow, polygon
d = dw.Drawing(820, 400)
d.append(dw.Rectangle(0, 0, 820, 400, fill='white'))
polygon(d, [(110, 280), (680, 280), (680, 345), (110, 345)], SOURCE, SOURCE)
polygon(d, [(110, 205), (680, 95), (680, 20), (110, 130)], TARGET, TARGET)
label(d, 'Source conductor', 130, 322, color=SOURCE)
label(d, 'Facing conductor', 360, 110, color=TARGET)
d.append(dw.Line(110, 280, 680, 280, stroke=SOURCE, stroke_width=4))
arrow(d, 80, 280, 765, 280)
arrow(d, 110, 365, 110, 55)
label(d, 'x', 775, 286)
label(d, 'y', 88, 45)
label(d, '0', 90, 306)
arrow(d, 195, 276, 195, 193, both=True, color=ACCENT)
label(d, 'd(x)', 208, 240, color=ACCENT)
arrow(d, 126, 276, 126, 206, both=True)
label(d, 'd₀', 135, 265, size=17)
arrow(d, 668, 276, 668, 99, both=True)
label(d, 'd₁', 680, 185, size=17)
polygon(d, [(377, 280), (393, 280), (393, 150), (377, 153)], ACCENT, ACCENT, 0.16)
label(d, 'dx', 384, 305, color=ACCENT, anchor='middle')
arrow(d, 110, 375, 680, 375, both=True)
label(d, 'Interval length L', 395, 365, anchor='middle')
d
```
